name: arr-management
description: Manage a home *arr media stack: add TV series and movies, clean up already-watched media, and health-check the download pipeline.
author: jdm0830

skills.name: arr-stack
skills.description: Config/plumbing layer: endpoints, keys, and API helpers for Sonarr, Radarr, and Plex. Shared by the other two skills.

skills.name: arr-add-media
skills.description: Add a TV series (Sonarr) or movie (Radarr): looks up the title, picks the quality profile and root folder, optionally starts a search.

skills.name: arr-watch-cleanup
skills.description: Delete media you've already watched: cross-references Plex watch history with Sonarr/Radarr, dry-runs, then removes watched items.
